name: prompt-compass
description: 每轮结束后给出最多三条下一步建议：默认用 Claude Code 自带的问答弹窗，也可改为输入框上方的按钮行；终端与桌面 App 均可用。

display.title: How to show suggestions
display.description: dialog: the built-in question dialog; band: a row above the prompt box.

autoSubmit.title: Send the chosen suggestion right away
autoSubmit.description: Dialog mode only. Off: the chosen suggestion is written into the prompt box as a draft. On: it is sent at once. The dialog always shows each suggestion's full prompt.

language.title: Language of the dialog and buttons
language.description: en: English; zh: Chinese; auto: follow the language of your latest message.

minAnswerChars.title: Shortest answer to suggest after
minAnswerChars.description: Skip suggestions after answers shorter than this many characters.

suggestSkills.title: Suggest skills and slash commands
suggestSkills.description: Tell the suggester which skills and slash commands this session has, so a suggestion can be one of them.
